selection_basis: Use one source-faithful parsimonious model fixed from the successfully reproduced external literature before Commodity translation outcomes are scored; do not tune model family, lag order, horizon, threshold, or transformations on Commodity research OOS.

variables: log real Henry Hub spot price
challenger.estimation: recursive OLS VAR with intercept using only the exact BHLR real-time vintage available at each forecast origin

benchmark: source-study monthly no-change forecast of the real Henry Hub spot price
horizon_policy: Evaluate the complete predeclared horizon family; no post-outcome horizon selection.

chronology.prepared_panel: common forecast origins for which all nine horizon targets through 24 months are available in the frozen source package
chronology.boundary_purge: purge every research origin whose 24-month target availability reaches or crosses the first reserved prediction timestamp

prediction_time: end of BHLR source-vintage month under a conservative 23:59 UTC monthly availability bound
target: source-study ex-post real Henry Hub spot price at each declared horizon
pit_rule: all challenger inputs come from the exact BHLR historical real-time vintage at the forecast origin; final revised values are outcome truth only

evaluation.uncertainty: paired moving-block bootstrap RMSE under the unchanged common Phase-1 block size of 20 observations

family_disposition.survive: At least five of nine horizons individually satisfy the frozen SURVIVE rule and at least one survivor occurs in each of the short [1,3,6], medium [9,12,15], and long [18,21,24] bands.
family_disposition.kill: At least five of nine horizons individually satisfy the frozen KILL rule.
family_disposition.inconclusive: Otherwise, including any pre-scoring uncertainty-capacity failure that prevents the declared horizon family from being evaluated.
family_disposition.purpose: Prevent a single favorable horizon from being cherry-picked after observing the horizon family.
